# Numerical reference fixtures

These synthetic fixtures were independently generated in the ML acceptance work,
not computed by this crate. They are copied into the production test suite so it
has no path dependency on development spikes or Python at runtime.

- `statistics.json`: statsmodels 0.14.6, NumPy 2.5.3, SciPy 1.18.1; OLS/classical/HC3,
  ordinary unpenalized logistic and known degenerate inputs. Source generator is
  `tools/ml-spikes/statistics/generate_reference.py`; copy its `reference.json` here
  as `statistics.json` after deliberate regeneration.
- `separation.json`: 24 seeded integer-input LP classifications from independent
  SciPy HiGHS, generated by that same script as `separation_reference.json`.
- `xgboost-*.json`: XGBoost 3.0 synthetic regression/binary/multiclass models,
  early-stopping policies and expected Python predictions. Source generators and
  exact environment are in `tools/ml-spikes/imports/`; copied files remain exact.

Tests use dtype-specific tolerances carried in the XGBoost fixtures and
`1e-8 + 1e-6 * abs(expected)` for the f64 statistical comparisons. Exact separation
certificates use no floating tolerance for final acceptance.
